$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: Paying only the minimum of {minimumDue} adds {totalInterestMinimum} in charges
templates.body: Your statement balance is {statementBalance} and the minimum due is {minimumDue}. Paying only the minimum each month, at {aprPct} a year, you would pay {totalPaidMinimum} in total, of which {totalInterestMinimum} is interest. templates.headline: Before you pay the minimum
templates.body: Paying only the minimum keeps your card in good standing, but the rest of the balance carries charges until it is paid. Paying more each month, or the full statement balance, lowers what you pay overall. You can ask us before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل سداد الحد الأدنى
templates.body: سداد الحد الأدنى فقط يحافظ على انتظام بطاقتك، لكن باقي الرصيد تترتب عليه رسوم حتى يُسدَّد. سداد مبلغ أكبر كل شهر أو كامل رصيد الكشف يخفّض إجمالي ما تدفعه. يمكنك سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.

en.minimum_payment_extends_repayment: Paying only the minimum spreads the balance over many months, and charges apply to what remains each month.
en.minimum_payment_does_not_clear_balance: At the minimum, the balance is not cleared within the period the bank checks.
en.severity_critical: The charges are above the level your bank has set for an important notice.
en.severity_caution: Your bank shows a notice for this situation.

ar.minimum_payment_extends_repayment: سداد الحد الأدنى فقط يوزّع الرصيد على أشهر كثيرة، وتُحتسب الرسوم على المتبقي كل شهر.
ar.minimum_payment_does_not_clear_balance: بسداد الحد الأدنى لا يُسدَّد الرصيد خلال الفترة التي يفحصها البنك.
ar.severity_critical: الرسوم أعلى من الحد الذي حدده البنك لإظهار تنبيه مهم.
ar.severity_caution: يُظهر البنك تنبيهاً في هذه الحالة.
